summary.text: David McCrea is the Democratic candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 3, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race with no incumbent against Republican Susan Y. Bernard.
A former teacher, he represented District 148 in the Maine House from 2016 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: David McCrea was born in Fort Fairfield, Maine, and graduated from Fort Fairfield High School in 1964.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Maine at Presque Isle in 1968 and a master's degree from the University of Maine at Orono in 1981.

His career experience includes working as a teacher, and Ballotpedia lists him as a member of the Maine Education Association, the National Education Association and the Fort Fairfield Teacher's Association and as a former Fort Fairfield town councilor.

McCrea represented District 148 in the Maine House of Representatives from 2016 until December 6, 2022, serving on the Education and Cultural Affairs and Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry committees.
According to Ballotpedia's campaign finance records, he lost the general election for District 3 in 2022 and again in 2024.
